create.title: Start a Club
create.intro: For people who want to do the same kind of thing again - not just meet once.
create.howItWorksBody: You begin as the founding host. Invite a few people, run a gathering, then regular membership grows from people who actually show up.
create.nameLabel: What should the Club be called?
create.descriptionPlaceholder: A friendly weekly game for people who want to get better and know the same faces.
create.cadenceLabel: How often do you want to meet?
create.discoverableHelp: It can appear in Club discovery. Your exact gathering locations stay private.
create.inviteOnlyHelp: The Club is private. You can invite founders directly.
create.required: Add a Club name and city to continue.
create.successBody: You are its founding host. The next step is inviting a few founders and planning the first gathering.
create.coverHelp: Upload your own photo or generate an illustrated cover from your Club details.
create.coverDetailLabel: Anything you want in the image?
create.coverDetailPlaceholder: e.g. sunset beach volleyball or a cosy café table
create.coverNeedsName: Add a Club name first so we know what to create.
create.coverUploadError: Couldn't upload that photo. Try again.

detail.notFoundBody: It may be private, closed, or no longer active.
detail.formingBody: A Club becomes real through the people who come back. Plan the first gathering, then invite the people you want to build it with.
detail.noGatheringBody: The first gathering will appear here once it is planned.
detail.privacyBody: Flockie does not show a Club roster or exact location here. Founders and regulars are earned through real participation.
detail.clubChatSub: The persistent room - plans, jokes, everything between gatherings.
detail.mediaCardSub: Photos, videos & files from the club

founders.title: Invite founding members
founders.body: Create a private, one-use link for someone you want to help shape this Club. They choose whether to accept.
founders.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy the link. Please try again.
founders.help: Links expire after 14 days. An accepted link cannot be used again.
founders.inviteError: Couldn’t create the invite link. Please try again.
founders.revokeError: Couldn’t revoke that link. Please try again.
founders.bodyOneLink: Your club has ONE invite link. Share it with anyone you want in - it admits everyone who has it, and copying it renews its validity.
founders.regenerate: Generate a new link (kills this one)
founders.regenConfirm: Generate a new link? The current one stops working for everyone who has it.

invite.title: Help shape {club}
invite.body: You’ve been invited to join the founding group. Founders help set the tone early - joining is your choice.
invite.acceptedBody: Welcome to {club}. You can now follow the Club as its first gatherings take shape.
invite.notFoundBody: It may have expired, been used, or been revoked by the host.
invite.nextGatheringHint: Accept the invite and you can grab your spot right away.
invite.confirmNext: Confirm attendance for the next event
invite.notFoundHostHint: If you are the club host, your own invite link will not open for you - ask someone else to test it.

heartbeat.readyBody: If it went ahead, make the Club active. This means it is now a recurring community, not just an idea.
heartbeat.activeBody: Plan the next gathering when you’re ready. We never create one automatically without you choosing the time and details.
heartbeat.pausedBody: It is hidden from Club discovery and founder invitations are paused. Existing gatherings are not cancelled.
heartbeat.pauseError: Couldn’t update this Club. Please try again.
heartbeat.closeBody: This permanently removes it from discovery and stops new founder invitations. Scheduled Vibes are not cancelled.

directory.title: Clubs
directory.intro: Small recurring communities, built through real gatherings - not a follower count.
directory.emptyBody: Start one around something you would genuinely like to keep doing. It begins as Forming - no fake members needed.

attendance.title: Record who came
attendance.body: Confirm the people who actually attended this gathering. This does not make anyone a Club member - it only makes them eligible to request it.
attendance.confirmBody: Only mark people who actually came. This attendance record cannot be removed here.
attendance.error: Couldn’t record attendance. Please try again.

membership.requestTitle: Want to make this a regular thing?
membership.requestBody: You attended a Club gathering. Request regular membership and the host will decide.
membership.requestedBody: The Club host will review it. You are not a regular member until they approve.
membership.declinedBody: You can keep joining gatherings if new spots open.
membership.requestError: Couldn’t send your request. Please try again.
membership.hostBody: These people attended a Club gathering and chose to request regular membership.
membership.declineBody: They will not become a regular member. They can still join future gatherings if eligible.
membership.decisionError: Couldn’t update this request. Please try again.
membership.introPlaceholder: What you have in common with the club, your story, your skills - and why you'd love to be part of it. The members will read this and vote.
membership.introTooShort: Write at least a few sentences - the members vote based on this.

convert.heading: Turn it into a club
convert.subtitle: "{title}" becomes the club's first gathering - the people who came are already in the story.
convert.inviteHint: Everyone who attended - untick anyone you'd rather not invite.

loop.invitedTitle: You're invited as a founding member 🎉
loop.invitedBody: The host picked you from the gathering you both attended. Accept to make it official.
loop.modeBody: The heartbeat: gatherings can be scheduled by you, or automatically by Flockie so the club survives busy weeks.
loop.modeAutoSub: Next gathering auto-scheduled on your cadence - same time, same place

chat.heading: Club chat
chat.empty: No messages yet - say hi to the club 👋

chatHeader.muted: Muted - no more pings from this club
chatHeader.reportMsg: Tell us what's wrong and we'll review it.
chatHeader.leaveMsg: You'll stop seeing the chat and gatherings. You can earn membership again by attending.

calendar.emptyBody: Your next gathering shows up here once it's set.
calendar.leaveConfirm: Free your spot at this gathering? The club's head count updates and someone else can take it.

moderators.title: Moderators
moderators.subtitle: Trusted members who can approve new members and record attendance - so the club runs even when you're away.
moderators.empty: No active members yet. People show up here once they accept their invite or you approve their request - then you can make them moderators.

media.title: Club media
media.subtitleManager: Photos, videos, and files for this club. Only the host and moderators can add or remove; every member can view and download.
media.subtitleMember: Photos, videos, and files shared by the club's host and moderators.
media.emptyManager: Nothing here yet. Upload photos from your gatherings, the club playlist, a PDF with house rules - anything the club should keep.
media.emptyMember: Nothing here yet - the host and moderators will share club photos and files in this space.
media.deleteConfirm: Remove this from the club media?

mine.title: My Clubs
mine.subtitle: Clubs you host or belong to.
mine.emptyBody: Join a club through its gatherings, or start your own around something you'd love to repeat.

socio.title: Membership
socio.subtitle: A paid monthly membership for the club. Members pay you directly or in-app - mark it here (or let checkout do it) and the app enforces the perks. No money passes through Flockie on manual payments.
socio.perksPlaceholder: e.g. free entry to gatherings, exclusive content, the monthly kit…
socio.memberHow: To become a paid member, pay in-app or directly to the host - they'll activate your membership here.

store.title: Club store
store.subtitleHost: List merchandise (kits, shirts, prints); members order and you confirm payment and delivery.
store.subtitleMember: Merchandise from the club. Order here, pay the host, and pick it up at a gathering.
store.orderPlaced: Order placed! Pay the host and they'll confirm it here.
store.payHint: Pay the host directly for now - in-app card checkout is coming.
store.emptyMember: No products yet - the host will list club merchandise here.
store.errProduct: Add a name and a valid price.

pay.error: Could not start the payment - try again.

voting.title: New member vote
voting.subtitle: The club decides together - majority of active members settles it. Your vote counts.

welcome.title: You're in!
welcome.body: The club voted to accept you. You're a member now - and if you want the full experience, there's the paid membership:

memberSettings.title: Your membership
memberSettings.showOnProfile: Show this club on my profile
memberSettings.leaveConfirm: Leave this club? You can ask to join again later through its gatherings.
memberSettings.paidNoRenew: Nothing renews automatically - if you don't pay again, you simply become a free member when it ends.
memberSettings.endPaidConfirm: End your paid membership now? You'll give up the remaining days and become a free member immediately.
memberSettings.endPaidDone: Paid membership ended - you're a free member now.
memberSettings.upgradeHint: Unlock the paid-member perks. Pay in-app, or directly to the host who activates it.
